text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-wha? When did I...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So this is what defeat feels like.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Frustration at failing to complete one's
task. And there is another
emotion too,
one that burns...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice Shower, this victory is yours.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I won?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You ran tremendously.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll be a more formidable
opponent. I hope to race you
again, Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me... me too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I really did it... I really won...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did it! McQueen! You guys! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeah, that's our Rice! She really
brought back the W!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She did! We couldn't have hoped for more!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Look,
she's coming to the stands! Let's all
call out to her! On three—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I dunno, this is kinda disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Here I was thinking I'd get to see
the birth of an undefeated
Triple Crown
legend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are more than just a couple of
comments like that. We were just
too busy
celebrating to notice until now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So this is what McQueen meant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My true concern was what would happen
should she deny the Triple
Crown so many
were hoping to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ambivalent mood enveloping the
racecourse seems to stifle our
cries of joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ambivalent mood enveloping the
racecourse seems to stifle our
cries of joy.
